Popovers

Add .popover to any .dropdown to turn it into a popover. Use data-popover-placement to set the side.

Placement sides

Set data-popover-placement to top, right, bottom, or left. The arrow automatically points back to the trigger.

Popover content on the top side.
Popover content on the right side.
Popover content on the bottom side.
Popover content on the left side.
Rich content

Popovers can contain forms, images, or any HTML content inside the dropdown-menu body.
